name: In-browser legacy Java Swing app runner (CheerpJ/WASM)

mentions.name: In-browser legacy Java Swing app runner (CheerpJ/WASM)
mentions.description: Runs legacy 20+ year old Java Swing desktop applications inside a web browser using WebAssembly, JS glue code, and the CheerpJ/OpenJDK runtime. Notes that WASM offers fast startup speed and a small memory footprint (beating the JVM) but performs poorly on compute, and that JDBC is broken because WASM lacks networking sockets.
mentions.source_excerpt: Making legacy 20+ years Java Swing apps run inside a Browser using WASM and JS glue code with CheerpJ/OpenJDK runtime.
